newsitem.title: UK: OFTEL says BT must give Mercury access.
newsitem.headline: OFTEL says BT must give Mercury access.

text.p: British telecommunications watchdog OFTEL said on Tuesday that British Telecommunications Plc must modify its payphones to allow customers of its rival Mercury to access Mercury services by dialing "133".
Mercury is a unit of Cable & Wireless.
"I consider that this determination will allow further competition to develop in the use of chargecards and other services,", said OFTEL chief Don Cruickshank.
OFTEL said Mercury customers will not have to use coins and will be billed by Mercury for the cost of the call. -- London Newwsroom +44 171 542 7717
